capabilities: Create and open daily review notes from a trading-day calendar
Record five-section reviews (market observation, plan verification, trades, reflection, next-day plan)
Search and filter past reviews by date, text, section, and completion
Generate optional AI text analysis of daily and weekly reviews
Maintain an A-share market holiday calendar with annual updates
disambiguation: Not an investment-advice or market-data tool; it only journals and reviews the user's own trades in Markdown notes.
extras: Optional donations via WeChat Pay and Alipay; README warns the plugin does not provide investment advice and that API keys are stored in plugin data.json.
problem: Obsidian has no structured workflow for recording and reviewing trading decisions day by day, including a trading-day calendar and carryover of prior plans.

relations.evidence: Annual calendar updates contact the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

summary: Local-first trading journal that creates daily review notes on an A-share trading-day calendar, with searchable history and optional AI daily/weekly analysis.
